name: zclass_camera_render_traverse
description: zClass_Camera::RenderTraverse renders visible camera nodes, applies camera transform context, and dispatches children.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for camera render traversal; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass render traversal source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja/source review validates visible-flag gating, transform-dirty clearing, clip-mask culling, camera matrix push/apply/pop, render callback, child dispatch, and bounds-context restoration.
The native render traversal dispatch smoke verifies dispatch into camera traversal, render callback invocation, transform-dirty clearing, and matrix stack restoration.
